checklists.title: Hero Characters
checklists.intro: The sixteen male heroes, built on two shared bodies (standard and large) with swappable heads. Every hero has a 52-shape face rig, textured hair and four levels of detail, and walks in Unreal. Remaining work: dedicated period outfits and the final sign-off pass.

checklists.title: Animations
checklists.intro: Every move starts as a sentence of plain English and is generated by a text-to-motion model running on a local GPU, then retargeted, cut, measured and fixed by script. Basic movement is in the game for both male bodies; the female set is generated and checked; combat clips are in Unreal and wait for their review pass.

legend.Generated: Four takes per clip, best take kept
legend.Ground fix: Pelvis and foot targets lowered to stand on the floor
legend.Arm pass: Weapon and shield arm poses fixed, shoulders squared, swing tied to the legs
legend.Visual review: Clip-by-clip review in the editor review room

checklists.title: Region Maps
checklists.intro: Eleven region maps built from real elevation and river data for western Britain. Each map is planted with its own plant list and streams with World Partition. The manor map has its buildings placed; the other ten have placeholder blocks where their buildings and scenes will go.

legend.Scale and warp: Empty land squeezed up to 1.25x, story sites kept true size, height never scaled
legend.Far-view build: Hierarchical level of detail for distant trees
legend.Buildings and scenes: Placeholder blocks replaced with finished buildings and scene sets
legend.Playtest: Crossing time and points of interest checked on foot

checklists.title: Trees
checklists.intro: 21 tree species built in Blender for KnightZ, 66 meshes in all, with a 5,000-triangle cap at full detail. Each species has growth variants, season states and lower levels of detail, and is assigned to the regions where it would really grow.

legend.Seasons: Spring, summer, autumn and winter from one switch
legend.LODs: Lower detail versions and far cards
legend.Autumn colour: Species colour group (red, orange, rust, gold or evergreen)

checklists.title: Sky, Light and Seasons
checklists.intro: The effects that run over every map: the volcanic ash sky, lightning, the red moon, the season switch, river water and firelight.

items.name: Ash cloud layer
items.sub: Heavy black ash from 1.5 to 5.3 km, a thin veil always over the sun so it glows red.

imgs.alt: Manor under the ash sky, sun clear

items.name: Sun cover passes
items.sub: A heavy cell crosses the sun every 6 to 14 minutes. Light drops to 30 percent, never to black.

items.name: Lightning
items.sub: Every 20 to 30 minutes, 1 to 3 strokes, 3 to 12 km away.

items.name: Thunder
items.sub: Delayed by distance at the speed of sound. Sound asset still to make.

items.name: Season switch
items.sub: One setting turns every plant to spring, summer, autumn or winter and sets the sun's day of the year.

imgs.alt: One woodland view in four seasons

items.name: Grass height by season
items.sub: Spring grass at half height, full from summer.

imgs.alt: Grass height by season and leaf colour groups

items.name: Autumn colour groups
items.sub: Red, orange, rust, gold and evergreen groups by species.

items.name: River water
items.sub: One continuous flow surface for the Severn and brooks; ford 50 cm deep.

items.name: Firelight
items.sub: Twelve flickering lights in the hall with a shared flicker pattern.

items.name: Cloud shadows on the ground
items.sub: Darkening now comes from the sky controller; cloud shadow maps still too weak.
